text:
Eli R: Heads up team — GigaTech asked to run a Private/on-prem POC starting next week. They want a short preflight (network, keys, drivers, k8s) + clarity on whether Dedicated pricing applies during POC and what happens if we need to switch to Hosted temporarily. Can someone take point on the tech checklist and a one-page security blurb?
Sam T: I can take the tech checklist. Quick question: are they planning for A100-80GB nodes or 40GB? Also need to know OS (RHEL8/Ubuntu22.04/etc).
Eli R: They listed A100-80GB for inferencing and 2x T4s for lightweight workloads. OS is RHEL 8.7.
Sam T: OK. Minimal driver/CUDA guidance for that stack: NVIDIA driver >= 525 recommended; CUDA 11.8+ tested. Ask them to run and paste outputs:
```
nvidia-smi -q | head -n 20
lspci -k | grep -A3 NVIDIA
cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version || true
kubectl version --short
kubectl get nodes -o wide
```
Sam T: Also ask for kernel version (uname -r) and whether they use kpatch/livepatch. If kernel gets upgraded during install we need a reboot window.
Nadia P: Network items: outbound HTTPS (TCP 443) to our control plane endpoints + DNS resolution. If they want us to run the installer, require a short-lived bastion with jumpbox access (we do NOT ask for broad SSH to worker nodes). For VPNs, confirm route propagation and that NAT rules don't SNAT our control plane.
Maya H: For k8s, our installer supports kubelet >=1.24 up to 1.27. We prefer containerd >=1.6.6. CNI should be Calico or AWS VPC-CNI; if they use custom CNI, we need the CNI manifest. Also note: iptables nft mode is ok, but DEBs on older RHEL may need iptables-legacy symlink.
FieldEngBot: Preflight checklist (draft): https://internal.redwood/fieldeng/checklists/1879991234 - includes GPU driver checks, kernel check, kube/containerd versions, required ports, suggested resource sizes.
Kara M: Security blurb for customer: Private deployment keeps model weights and request data inside your VPC. We support customer-managed keys (AWS KMS or Azure KeyVault) and can forward audit logs to a customer bucket. I'll prepare a one-page Q&A (data residency, encryption, auth flows, breach notification).
SalesOps: Pricing note: For POC we can offer Hosted trial credits OR a short-term Dedicated trial rate. If they run Private but we fail over to Hosted for capacity reasons, Hosted usage will be billed at hosted public rates; Sales can approve a discretionary courtesy credit up to $3k for the POC if requested. Confirm which option customer prefers before sign-off.
Eli R: Action items: Sam 1 - assemble the short tech checklist + the exact commands and send to GigaTech; Nadia 1 - write the minimum network matrix they'll need to validate with infra; Kara 1 - short security Q&A; SalesOps 1 - document the POC billing fallback and confirm credit cap. I'll combine and send in one email.
Sam T: Driver snippet for email copy: "Recommend NVIDIA driver 525+. Please run `nvidia-smi -q` and include kernel/driver output. If using custom kernel modules or older RHEL, include dkms/out-of-tree module notes; installer may require a reboot"
Nadia P: Network checklist highlights for email copy: outbound 443 to control-plane endpoints, DNS to our control plane domains, reachable NTP, optional bastion for ops (restrict by IP), and confirmation of VPN route propagation.
Maya H: Add this k8s quick check they can paste into support ticket:
```
kubectl get nodes -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}: {.status.nodeInfo.kubeletVersion}
'{end}
containerd --version || crictl --version
```
Kara M: I'll attach the DPA excerpt and the short Q&A. Will also note customer KMS ARN + minimal IAM role for assume-role flow (we'll request a role that allows Encrypt/Decrypt for the key).
Eli R: Perfect. I'll send by EOD and schedule a 30m preflight call once they return the outputs. :thumbsup:
SalesOps: Confirmed POC credit policy in our CRM. Will escalate if they ask for more than $3k.
FieldEngBot: Reminder set to follow up in 48h if outputs not received.
